definitions.explanation: Regular payments received after retirement, funded by contributions during working years.
Fixed payments received at regular intervals from an investment or insurance.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん}に{加入|かにゅう}している。
examples.english: I'm enrolled in the national pension system.

examples.japanese: {年金|ねんきん}だけでは{生活|せいかつ}が{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to live on pension alone.

examples.japanese: {年金|ねんきん}は65{歳|さい}から{受|う}け{取|と}れる。
examples.english: You can receive pension starting at age 65.

notes:
{年金|ねんきん} is a compound: {年|ねん} (year) + {金|きん} (money).

JAPANESE PENSION TYPES:
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん} (National Pension - basic, mandatory for all)
- {厚生|こうせい}{年金|ねんきん} (Employees' Pension - for company employees)
- {企業|きぎょう}{年金|ねんきん} (Corporate pension)
- {個人|こじん}{年金|ねんきん} (Personal/private pension)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年金|ねんきん}を{払|はら}う (to pay pension premiums)
- {年金|ねんきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る (to receive pension)
- {年金|ねんきん}に{加入|かにゅう}する (to enroll in pension)
- {年金|ねんきん}{受給|じゅきゅう} (pension receipt)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's aging society has put pressure on the pension system. {年金問題|ねんきんもんだい} (pension issues) is a frequent topic of discussion.
